name: Design of Reinforced Concrete Structures
description: Fresh and hardened properties of concrete; Durability of reinforced concrete; Design philosophy and safety; Working stress design and Limit state design concepts; Design for flexure, shear, torsion, bond and axial actions; Design and detailing of beams, slabs, and footings for serviceability and ultimate limit states as per national design standards.
